text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the 
 inspection check I1, which must be performed on a
 daily bases as indicated by D1 in the title block
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued, and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes,
 hearing protection, rubber, gloves ...etc.
Tools and Equipment
Test equipment level "dip sticks", multimeter.
Common sets keys, cleaning material "rags, cloth" and screw driver set.
Work to be 
Carried out
Change the operation position from automatic to local.
Check for oil leaks.
Check for water leaks.
Check for fuel leaks.
Check start switch in automatic.
Change the operation position from automatic to local.
Check for oil leaks.
Check for water leaks.
Check for fuel leaks.
Check start switch in automatic.
Make overall visiual inspection.
Check alarm signals and reset it if it is found.
Change the operation position from local to automatic.
